scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Net APY on equity = collateral yield × leverage − borrow rate × (leverage − 1).
Correlated loops (an LST against its underlying, or stablecoin against stablecoin) are…
scenes.vo: First, Liquidity without selling: borrow stablecoins against assets you want to keep (Module 12.3 turns this into a credit policy). Next, Looping: deposit to borrow to re-deposit to repeat, to multiply exposure. After n loops at L.T.V. L: leverage = (1 minus L^(n+1)) divided by (1 minus L). Then, Net A.P.Y. on equity equals collateral yield times leverage minus borrow rate times (leverage minus 1). And finally, Correlated loops (an liquid staking token against its underlying, or stablecoin against stablecoin) are far safer than volatile-against-stable loops.
scenes.cap: First, Liquidity without selling: borrow stablecoins against assets you want to keep (Module 12.3 turns this into a credit policy). Next, Looping: deposit → borrow → re-deposit → repeat, to multiply exposure. After n loops at LTV L: leverage = (1 − L^(n+1)) ÷ (1 − L). Then, Net APY on equity = collateral yield × leverage − borrow rate × (leverage − 1). And finally, Correlated loops (an LST against its underlying, or stablecoin against stablecoin) are far safer than volatile-against-stable loops.

scenes.title: Worked example
steps: The return is wiped out if borrow rises to 5.78%.
Section 3.1 showed borrow rates can jump from 4% to 34% in hours.
scenes.vo: Let's work an example, step by step. L.T.V. 0.7, 3 loops, 3.5% collateral yield, 2.5% borrow: the calculator to 2.53 times leverage, 5.03% net on equity. The return is wiped out if borrow rises to 5.78%. Section 3.1 showed borrow rates can jump from 4% to 34% in hours. That's the risk.
